title: AuspexAI Executor Output v0.1
description: What a tenant executor writes to its --output path. The worker daemon (which holds the keystore) reads this, adds worker_pubkey + worker_signature, and submits the full Result to the coordinator. Distinct from the Result envelope (result_v0_1.json) — this is the executor → worker handoff format. Tenant authors writing executors in any language (Python, Rust, Go, shell) target this schema; the worker validates against it before constructing the full Result.

unit_id.description: Matches the unit_id of the work unit this output is for. The worker verifies this match before constructing the Result.

completed_at.description: When the executor finished. The worker may use this for log correlation; the coordinator uses the worker's submission time for time-window metadata in receipts.

exit_code.description: Tenant-defined exit code. 0 indicates the work itself succeeded; non-zero indicates the work failed in a tenant-meaningful way (e.g., model output failed a sanity check). Distinct from the executor *process* exit code, which signals whether the harness itself ran (process exit 1 = tenant code raised; process exit 2 = harness/IO error).

payload.description: Tenant-defined result content. Opaque to the AuspexAI platform; the tenant's reducer (if any) and downstream analysis pipeline are the only consumers.
